# incusos_system_provider (Resource)

Manages the IncusOS update and configuration provider (`/1.0/system/provider`), such as `images` or `operations-center`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Provider name (e.g., `images`, `operations-center`).

### Optional

- `config` (Map of String) Provider-specific key-value configuration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `registered` (Boolean) Whether the host is currently registered with the provider.
